summary: Product Constitution is canonical doctrine at authority level 1.
must: Product, business, user-loop, trust, and brand constraints live here.
mustNot: Do not treat lower-authority docs as winners over constitutions.

summary: Source-Of-Truth Constitution is canonical doctrine at authority level 2.
must: contract -> server truth -> client projection -> UI display -> telemetry -> validator -> docs
mustNot: Do not treat lower-authority docs as winners over constitutions.

summary: Engineering Constitution is canonical doctrine at authority level 3.
must: Agents read compact context first.
Do not read every Markdown file by default.
Broad audits are forbidden by default.
mustNot: Do not treat lower-authority docs as winners over constitutions.

summary: admin-ai surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Admin AI uses shared model registry and budget controls.
mustNot: Hardcoded model aliases outside registry are blocked.

summary: admin-debug surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Admin debug labels live/cached/stale/fallback/partial/failed/unknown.
Generated reports remain snapshots.
mustNot: Generated reports cannot be canonical doctrine.
Missing data cannot render healthy.

summary: behavioral-intelligence surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Raw events normalize before scoring.
Deterministic ranking remains safety baseline.
mustNot: Unknown events cannot become production facts.
ML artifacts cannot activate without validation.

summary: cloud/sql/bigquery surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Data Connect and Cloud SQL remain agent-context mirror unless explicitly promoted.
mustNot: SQL/Data Connect cannot serve runtime user/payment/drop/chat/support/creator flows without ApiCostContract.

summary: creator-dashboard surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Creator paid experiences use paid-source GumDrops where required.
Expected failures return typed safe errors.
mustNot: Reward GumDrops cannot start or renew Fan Pass.
Projection writes cannot become live creator behavior.

summary: creator-profile surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Fan profile actions target creators without becoming creator behavior.
mustNot: Admin projection cannot be public profile truth.

summary: device-ui surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Use shared device layout and mobile shell helpers.
mustNot: Do not freestyle viewport math or raw shell 100vh.

summary: drops surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Full-page locked preview is canonical.
Unlocks count server entitlement facts only.
mustNot: Preview modal cannot become canonical.
Client unlock success cannot count as canonical unlock.

summary: image-loading surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Use surface-based image policy and accurate sizes.
mustNot: No internal thumbnails before entitlement truth.

summary: moderation surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Screenshot-like signals remain weak heuristic context unless confirmed by platform/server evidence.
mustNot: Browser/PWA screenshot heuristics cannot be confirmed facts.

summary: security/cost surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: API routes declare auth, origin, rate, idempotency, cache, cost, and failure contracts.
mustNot: Broad browser audits are not first-line security checks.

summary: support surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Bug reports and support tickets feed user timeline and debug evidence.
mustNot: Admin support actions cannot count as user behavior.

summary: telemetry surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Actor ids identify performer and target ids identify affected entity.
Server truth anchors purchase and unlock metrics.
mustNot: Admin/projection events cannot contaminate user metrics.
notification_opened and notification_read are not separate behavior scores.

summary: user-management surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Admin user metrics read normalized user facts.
Admin cards label source state honestly.
mustNot: Admin QA cannot count as user behavior.
Missing data cannot render healthy.

summary: viewer surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Visible media emits file_viewed with viewerSessionId.
File views connect to watch sessions.
mustNot: No internal content URLs in telemetry.
Render-time media mapping is not a view.

summary: wallet surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Revenue and user value read server purchase or ledger transaction truth.
Wallet preserves paid vs reward GumDrop source accounting.
mustNot: Client-only purchase completion cannot inflate revenue.
Total-only balance chips are not canonical.

summary: watch-time surface doctrine is canonical doctrine at authority level 4.
must: Watch time is foreground visible engagement.
Behavioral intelligence prefers watch-session rollups.
mustNot: Page duration is not canonical watch time.
Hidden or idle time is excluded.

summary: Behavioral Math Calibration is supporting doctrine at authority level 5.
must: Raw events normalize before scoring.
Deterministic ranking remains safety baseline.
mustNot: Unknown events cannot become production facts.
ML artifacts cannot activate without validation.
